summary: The SiteDocument entity represents documents associated with a site in the HSPnet application, containing references to SiteID and document ID. Content is minimal, primarily structural.
purpose: To record and manage documents linked to specific sites.
content_gaps: No workflows, validations, business rules, or system behaviors are described.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin defines user interface (UI) elements and backend logic for staff admin welcome pages, managing login, error/warning panels, date selection, site and discipline filtering, and employment application workflow.
purpose: To provide a filtered and interactive dashboard for staff admins to view and manage employment applications, errors, warnings, and login history.

workflows.name: Employment Application Filtering and Review
steps: User selects Site and Discipline using dropdowns.
User enters Start and End Dates; calendar widgets and validators enforce date input.
User clicks 'Refresh View' to update the data grid.
Grid displays filtered applications, including name, email, site, program, status, withdrawn date, etc.
User can review errors and warnings in panels, and hide/show these panels as needed.

business_rules: RequiredFieldValidator and RegularExpressionValidator enforce that Start/End Dates are present and valid.
Applications grid shows submitted or withdrawn status, with withdrawn date displayed if applicable.
validations: Start date must not be after end date (CustomValidator)
conditions: If UserSession or SiteID is missing, dropdowns default to agency site or site from query string.
If grid row is a withdrawn application, display additional info.
system_behavior: Page loads with user preferred name and timezone, last login displayed.
Refresh button updates the applications grid based on filters.
Panels for errors/warnings are always visible and can be hidden.
DataSource uses agency, discipline, site, and date as parameters for filtering.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data selection is canceled.
content_gaps: No advanced business rules or exceptional workflows detailed. No precise application data model definitions.

summary: ServiceCode represents a classification or type of service within the system, with localized names, notes, and sort order, used for filtering or organizing courses/timetables.
purpose: To categorize and provide details for services, allowing for localization and sorting/filtering in workflows involving course or timetable management.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: Fetch all service codes (ServiceCodeListAll) based on session.
Fetch service codes by CourseID or TimetableID for ASM options.

business_rules: If alternative language mode is enabled, use alt-language fields for name and notes.
system_behavior: Service codes are populated from database procedures and returned as lists.
content_gaps: No workflow for how service codes are used in downstream business processes.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks change events (audits) on site profile data, storing user actions, fields changed, responsible agency/user, and phone, with formatted display for audit purposes.
purpose: To provide an audit trail of changes to site profiles, including who performed the action, when, and what was changed.

workflows.name: Site Profile Change Audit
steps: User or SysAdmin changes site profile details.
Audit entry is created with details on action, fields, actor, date, and formatted summary.

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID differs from ByOriginalUserID, show support team attribution.
Localize fields if alt-language is enabled.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted concatenates role/team/user info with agency/initials.
conditions: If phone exists, show as part of formatted tooltip.
Show support team attribution only when applicable.
system_behavior: Audit information is presented as formatted strings for tooltips and displays.
Audit entries are retrieved by SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
content_gaps: No information on error handling or integrations with the main site profile editing UI.

summary: EmailPopupDocument manages documents sent through email popups, containing file metadata and supporting searching and deletion of documents, including file and folder cleanup.
purpose: To enable users to review, manage (search/delete), and track documents associated with email popups in the system.

workflows.name: Email Popup Document Search and Deletion
steps: Search: Split DataInfo string, enumerate, and create document entries with ID, FileName, FilePath.
Delete: Find entry by ID, delete file and folder, return updated DataInfo string.

business_rules: Document with valid FileName/FilePath must be deleted by ID.
If folder is empty after deletion, clean up folder.
validations: DataInfo string must be non-empty for search/delete actions.
conditions: File deletion and folder deletion only proceed if file/folder exists.
system_behavior: Search method enumerates DataInfo string into document objects.
Delete method removes file and folder, updates DataInfo.
exceptions: Try/catch blocks prevent exceptions on file/folder deletion.
content_gaps: No information on document upload or integration with UI email popup dialogs.
